text: Vienna-based Bitpanda was co-founded by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer. Its holding company is Bitpanda Group AG, whose supervisory board includes the three founders. Valar Ventures led Bitpanda's 2021 funding round, with unnamed partners from DST Global.
short: Bitpanda's holding company is Bitpanda Group AG; the three co-founders sit on its supervisory board.

source.name: Bitpanda Group, About us (timeline and leadership)
source.quote: Founded in Vienna by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek, Christian Trummer with a mission to make Bitcoin accessible to everyone.
